tips.title: Thinning Vallejo Model Air vs Model Color
tips.text: Vallejo Model Air is designed for airbrushing and doesn't require thinning. For Model Color, mix at a 2:1 ratio with Vallejo Airbrush Thinner (71.261). Add 2-3 drops of Vallejo Flow Improver (71.262) per 10 drops of thinned paint. Airbrush at 1.5-2.0 bar pressure using an Iwata HP-CS or Harder & Steenbeck Evolution.

tips.title: Base Coat Technique with Vallejo
tips.text: Start with Vallejo Acrylic Primer (71.036) to prepare your model's surface. Apply two light coats with your airbrush, allowing 24 hours between coats. Once dry, apply two coats of Vallejo Model Color (70.0xx series) using a fine nozzle (0.2-0.3mm) and 1.5-2.0 bar pressure, maintaining a consistent distance of 4-6 inches.

tips.title: Camouflage Masking with Eduard Mask Set
tips.text: Use Eduard's pre-cut masking sets (718xx series) for complex camouflage schemes. Apply masking film to the model, pressing down gently to avoid creases. Use a toothpick or scribing tool to burnish the edges, ensuring a tight seal. Apply paint with an airbrush, maintaining consistent pressure and distance. Remove masks carefully after paint is completely dry.

tips.title: Applying AK Interactive Washes
tips.text: Thin AK Interactive Washes (AK-010xx series) with AK Interactive Thinner (AK-2001) at a 1:1 ratio. Apply with a fine brush, working from top to bottom to avoid creating pools. Allow 5-10 minutes drying time before gently wiping off excess with a damp cotton swab. Seal with Vallejo Acrylic Gloss Varnish (71.038) before applying flat coat.

tips.title: Chipping with Sponge Technique
tips.text: For chipping effects, use a synthetic sponge (Mr. Hobby 2067) and Tamiya Acrylic Paint (TS-xxx series) mixed with Tamiya Acrylic Thinner (76101) at a 1:1 ratio. Dip the sponge into the paint mixture, gently pat onto the model where chipping is desired. Blot with a tissue while wet, then allow to dry completely. Seal with Vallejo Acrylic Matt Varnish (71.037) for a subtle effect.
